text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume and her trainer are two
parts of a whole. They
encourage and
support each other to achieve victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The trainer's role is to draw out the full
potential of an Umamusume
through
rigorous daily practice.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So I need to pull out all the stops for
Gold
Ship's training in order for
her to seize the
win!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heya, Trainer! Hope you're ready to
plunder an underwater temple!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You implying that exploring some
sunken ruins isn't training?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: There's ancient splendor in the deep! And you're saying the noble pursuit of the unknown is not training?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Well, you'd be absolutely right.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Anywho, it seems like you really wanna
practice today. Fret not, good
trainer, I
totally get where you're coming from.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
When I say hey, you say ho. I'm the
Sherlock to your Holmes.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
We're so close, we don't need silly ol'
words to get in the way! So let's
hit the
road! Follow meee!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I never thought we'd be on the same page!
I'd better hurry after her
to the track!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now that we're finally at the training
course... Wait, this isn't the
track.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Uwaaagh! Fish! Fish! Fishin' for fish!
What's our catch gonna be?
We're going after the
largest—the hugest! It's big catch or
nothing!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Geez,
don't just stand there! We're in this
together!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Seriously? We came all the way to the
waterfront. Obviously, the only
thing we
can do is go fishing!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
My poor old pops, the best fisher in the
village, retired from duty
before he could
ever catch the big granddaddy of this
river...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
That's why! As his proud daughter, I'm
gonna catch that legend! Arrrgh! Get
ready,
you jerk fish! I'll get you if it's the
last thing I do!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My head's still reeling from all this,
but we
cast our lines into the river.
Several
minutes later...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
It's no good. The only thing we've caught
are stupid water weeds.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Urrrgh! Aaaagh! I can't take it—I'm about
to collapse from boredom!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Follow me,
Trainer! I'm setting our sails for
Mars!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This could be good! Maybe she got so
bored she finally wants to start
training!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, waitress! One grilled fish platter,
and
pile that rice high!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Pheeew,
that was a close call. We got zilch
from fishing, but eating a
big one here
should make up for it!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Enough talk—time to dig in!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mere seconds after her fish platter
arrives,
she downs the whole meal
in a few gulps...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ahh, just what I needed. I'm eternally
grateful for the existence of
sustenance.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What? You mean to tell me fishing for fish
and then eating fish isn't
training?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
We're living off the land here. It's a
struggle for survival, fraught with
danger...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Living in harmony with nature and honing
our senses in the wild—open
your eyes. It's
all connected to racing!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Nah, it's probably no help at all!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
In that case, now that I've had a meal,
might as well head over to
Golshi Farms
and tend the carrots.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Catch you on the other side of the solar
system! Farewell!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's out the door by the time I
realize we
went the entire day
without doing a
minute of training...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: An Umamusume and trainer are two parts of a whole... We're supposed to work together to achieve victory!
